inputs.text: DHS is using a baby’s medical emergency in a crowded TSA line at JFK to manufacture an ICE hero narrative. They control the footage, so what they’re showing is a polished version designed to steer public opinion—not proof that we’ve seen the whole story. This looks like image management dressed up as transparency.
